name: @aiti-ai/aiti-proc-tree
description: Child-process tree manager — list every process the pi-web ecosystem spawns (terminals, tunnels, subagents, external agents), with CPU/memory and subtree stop; samples only while the panel is open

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 子进程管理——树形列出 pi-web 生态派生的子进程（终端/隧道/子代理/外部 Agent），实时 CPU/内存，可结束单进程或整棵子树；面板打开才采样，折叠即停

soul: 谁在跑、吃多少、从哪来——一棵树看全，点一下就能停。

soulI18n.en: Who is running, how much it eats, where it came from — one tree, one click to stop.
